name: synapse-upload
description: AI-powered data upload for Synapse - map files to data collection specs and upload via CLI

interface.shortDescription: Map and upload local or remote files into Synapse data collections.
interface.longDescription: Synapse Upload helps inspect local, S3, GCS, SFTP, or storage-relative sources, map files to data collection file specifications, handle metadata, and upload through the Synapse CLI.
defaultPrompt: Help me upload files or datasets into a Synapse data collection.
